title: Be an Internet Detective!
description: Solve puzzles and drag rules to learn about internet safety and etiquette. Protect your digital footprint!

title: Strawberry Math Orchard
description: Harvest delicious strawberries by solving additions, subtractions, and cool math puzzles in the orchard!

title: Space Rover Coding
description: Help the strawberry rover navigate Mars! Learn block-based coding, logic loops, and sequential directions.

title: Strawberry Story Builder
description: Become an author! Create interactive stories with strawberry characters, making your own choices along the way.

title: Strawberry Seed Spelling
description: Help the busy honey bees collect pollen by spelling grade-level words. Grow your vocabulary!

title: Paint Your Strawberry Mascot
description: Express your creativity! Design, color, and customize your own cute strawberry mascot character.
